title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
director: Jun Fukuda, Yoshimitsu Banno, Ishirô Honda
writer: Jun Fukuda, Takeshi Kimura, Shin'ichi Sekizawa
actors: Katsuhiko Sasaki, Hiroyuki Kawase, Yutaka Hayashi
plot: An inventor creates a robot that is seized by an undersea kingdom to guide their monster god in attacking the surface as retaliation for the nuclear tests that have devastated their society.
